title: Measure the standards pull rule after two weeks
body:
Outcome: query calls per interactive session is printed as a number from the session records on or after 2026-11-30 (two weeks after the standards skill ships); below 0.2 stops all pull work (no MCP server, no skill tuning) per ADR 0020.
Proof: `bin/krn standards effect: query-calls-per-session printed as a number`
